audience: managers and HR teams who run peer recognition on Bonusly

useCases.title: Find who gave and received the most bonuses
useCases.text: List the bonuses in the company, filtered by time, giver or hashtag. Read the bonuses that one user gave or received.

useCases.title: Find a colleague's id before giving a bonus
useCases.text: Search users by name or email to find their id. Then read that user's profile.

useCases.title: Give a bonus for a colleague's work
useCases.text: Give a bonus with a reason that names the recipients and a hashtag. Bonusly reads the amount, the recipients and the hashtags from the reason.

useCases.title: Correct a bonus reason within the edit window
useCases.text: Read one bonus, then change its reason text. Bonusly allows edits only for a short time after the bonus is created.

useCases.title: Review achievements and redemptions
useCases.text: List the 50 most recent achievements and the fulfilled reward redemptions. The redemption list needs an admin token.

useCases.title: Check which company a token can use
useCases.text: Show the company, scopes and user behind the token. Read the company details for the token's user.
